meta.name: fit-scorer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "score this influencer", "rank these creators for our campaign", or "tell me which influencer is the best fit"; produces weighted fit scores across audience match, content quality, brand alignment, engagement authenticity, and partnership potential, plus a ranked comparison and a go/pass verdict. Not for finding new influencers — use influencer-discovery; not for sending outreach — use outreach-manager.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估网红与品牌匹配度，给出合作建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从候选网红中选出最适合品牌合作的人选。
copy.tagline_en: Score influencer-brand fit and get go/pass verdicts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pick the best influencer for your campaign.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据受众匹配、内容质量、品牌契合度、互动真实性和合作潜力五个维度，给每个网红打分并排名，最后给出“推荐”或“放弃”的结论。
howto.when: 当你给出一个网红候选名单，要求评分、排名或判断谁最合适时触发。例如说“给这个网红打分”或“比较并排名这些创作者”。

say.text: 请给 @ecofashionista 为我们的可持续时尚品牌打分。
say.note: Claude 会输出五个维度的分数和总体推荐。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude scores each influencer across five dimensions (audience match, content quality, brand alignment, engagement authenticity, partnership potential), produces a weighted total, ranks them, and gives a go/pass verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide a shortlist of influencers and ask to score, rank, or determine the best fit. For example, "score this influencer" or "compare and rank these creators."

say_en.text: Score @ecofashionista for our sustainable fashion brand.
say_en.note: Claude outputs dimension scores and a verdict.

say_en.text: Compare and rank @influencer1, @influencer2, @influencer3 for our new campaign.
say_en.note: Claude produces a ranked comparison with verdicts.
